gabi_cs: heads-up  i'm prototyping a stratified onboarding-gap sampler to tune playbook noise. plan: 300-sample manual review stratified by ARR band, tag = `cs:onboard-gap-check`. ok to proceed? :mag:

ryan_eng: yep. define seed pls. i'd do owner_assigned = true AND onboard_steps_completed < 3 AND last_activity_at < now() - interval '30 days'. stratify by arr_band so enterprise isn't drowned out.

ming_ops: agree. proposer SQL (randomized stratified):

```sql
-- sample 300 stratified by arr_band
WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT *, ntile(3) OVER (ORDER BY arr_band) AS arr_bucket
  FROM accounts
  WHERE owner_assigned = true
    AND onboard_steps_completed < 3
    AND last_activity_at < now() - interval '30 days'
)
SELECT account_id, owner, arr_band, healthscore, onboard_steps_completed, last_activity_at
FROM buckets
WHERE arr_bucket = 1
ORDER BY random()
LIMIT 100; -- repeat per bucket
```

ming_ops: i'll output CSV with headers: account_id,owner,primary_contact,last_engagement,last_activity_at,healthscore,open_tasks_count,arr_band,reason_notes. reviewers will get 25 each.

gabi_cs: workflow: tag `cs:onboard-gap-check`; reviewer outcomes = no_action | nudge_email | escalate_ae | reassign_owner. when automated, prefer percentile per arr_band (bottom 20%) with fallback absolute_threshold=30. also add `soft_queue_hours=48` where auto-escalations land for human validation.

tara_se: please include last_touch_channel and last_touch_summary columns so reviewers have quick context. also ask reviewers to add a 1-line rationale when escalating.

ryan_eng: ops ask: capture metrics for pilot: pct_needing_action, false_positive_rate, avg_time_to_first_action, conversion_14d. we'll gate automation on false_positive_rate < 15%.

csbot: Reminder: "Onboard gap pilot kickoff" scheduled Wed 09:30. Invite sent. :calendar:

ming_ops: i'll wire the sampler + tagging lambda and open a PR with SQL + python tag snippet by EOD. gabi_cs will own the rubric.

gabi_cs: lovely  thanks all :thumbsup:
